Sander2023.title: Sander (2023), Compilation of Henry's law constants, version 5.0.0
Sander2023.use: Hcp definition and 298.15 K values; temperature slopes are local van't Hoff fits, not global phase-equilibrium laws.

CO_H.origin: Burkholder 2019 review; consistent with Rettich et al. 1982 measurements, DOI 10.1002/BBPC.198200051

isoprene_H.origin: Plyasunov and Shock 2000 literature value. Recent measured entries reach 3.4e-4; this spread is explicitly explored.

H2O2_H.origin: Burkholder 2019 review; neutral H2O2 in dilute water

N2_H.origin: 298.15 K database value; temperature slope not used in headline results

O2_H.origin: 298.15 K database value; temperature slope not used in headline results

USGS2012.title: USGS technical memorandum 2012.05, carbonate speciation
USGS2012.use: At 25 C, dilute freshwater: Kw=1e-14, K1=10^-6.35, K2=10^-10.33. CO2* apparent acid convention. No salinity/activity corrections.

MurphyKoop2005.title: Murphy and Koop, QJRMS 131, 1539-1565 (2005)
MurphyKoop2005.use: Equations 7 (ice) and 10 (liquid water) vapor pressure in Pa with T in K.

NIST2006.title: Mulholland et al. (2006), NIST aerosol size measurements
NIST2006.use: Section 3.3 eq18 Kim slip coefficients 1.165, 0.483, 0.997; mean free path 67.3 nm at 296.15K, 101.325kPa; Sutherland scaling.

IceAcetone2006.title: Acetone Adsorption on Ice Surfaces in the Temperature Range T=190-220K: Evidence for Aging Effects Due to Crystallographic Changes of the Adsorption Sites
IceAcetone2006.use: Two-site adsorption/desorption rate fits and capacities from abstract. k_ads1=3.8e-14 sqrt(T), k_des1=4e11 exp(-5773/T); k_ads2=2.9e-15 sqrt(T), k_des2=1.5e7 exp(-3488/T). k_ads in cm3 molecule^-1 s^-1, k_des in s^-1. Capacity1 <=1e14 cm^-2, capacity2=6e14 cm^-2. Assume the upper bound for site1. Kinetic ratios used consistently; separately fitted equilibrium parameters not substituted.

Depee2021.title: Depee et al. (2021), Laboratory study of collection efficiency of submicron aerosol particles by cloud droplets, Part I
Depee2021.use: Evidence that humidity, phoresis, particle/drop size and collection efficiency matter. Our simplified diffusion kernel is not fitted or validated against these measurements.

Gilardoni2014.title: Gilardoni et al. (2014), Fog scavenging of organic and inorganic aerosol in the Po Valley
Gilardoni2014.use: Smoke/aerosol composition and hygroscopicity matter; activation and impaction cannot be inferred from particle mass alone.

Do2009.title: Do et al. (2009), Hydrogen peroxide decomposition on manganese oxide (pyrolusite): kinetics, intermediates, and mechanism
Do2009.use: pH7 catalytic decomposition, observed maximum kobs=.741 min^-1 at H2O2/surface-site ratio11.8. Full temperature/loading specification not recovered; NOT applied to clean water or generic smoke and NOT simulated.

IUPAC_CO_OH.title: IUPAC datasheet HOx_VOC10, evaluation updated 2005
IUPAC_CO_OH.use: Evaluated combined k=1.44e-13(1+[N2]/4.2e19) cm3 molecule^-1 s^-1 over200-300K, 0-1bar N2. Low-pressure channel CO+OH->CO2+H simulated at298.15K,100Pa inN2 with k0=1.44e-13; combined pressure correction <0.06%, neglected HOCO stabilization. Finite OH inventory. No rate borrowed for CO+water. Quoted log10(k) reliability +/-0.05 used in sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval.

Crowley2010.title: Crowley et al. (2010), Evaluated heterogeneous chemistry on solid substrates
Crowley2010.use: Ice surface chemistry requires species- and temperature-specific uptake data; liquid Henry constants cannot be used as ice adsorption constants.

Provenance.note: Reference constants transcribed from linked sources. All geometric, concentration, flow, diffusivity and transfer-coefficient choices are modeling assumptions unless explicitly sourced. Numeric results are simulations, not laboratory observations.
